task: Microscopic phase separation between low-energy orbital scissors mode and high-spin magnetic rotation

results.regime: Pure Magnetic Rotation Shears Band (Scissors Vanished)

primary_papers: Bohle et al., Phys. Lett. B 137, 27 (1984)
Heyde, von Neumann-Cosel, Richter, Rev. Mod. Phys. 82, 2365 (2010)
Clark & Macchiavelli, Annu. Rev. Nucl. Part. Sci. 50, 1 (2000)
evidence_boundaries.mechanistic_law: Establishes that the low-energy 1+ orbital scissors mode and high-spin magnetic rotation shears bands belong to mutually exclusive deformation regimes governed by beta2: for beta2 > 0.20 (156Gd, 238U), the M1 strength is concentrated in a coherent 1+ two-fluid vibration (B(M1) ~ 3 mu_N^2 proportional to beta2^2) while high-spin shears are dynamically vetoed by collective rotation; whereas for beta2 < 0.12 (198Pb), the coherent scissors vibration vanishes and M1 collectivity reorganizes into multi-quasiparticle high-spin shears cascades.
